_doc: W17.3 cel-spec upstream pin record (VAL-W17-010). celspec_commit_sha is the commit google/cel-spec tag v0.20.0 points at; it MUST equal the first non-comment line of PINNED_COMMIT.txt (the drift checker asserts the equality) and the nightly workflow asserts it resolves on the cel-spec remote. The corpus is regenerated from this exact commit by scripts/build-celspec-corpus.py and verified against the SINGLE relay_cel_wasm engine (the legacy two-engine py-vs-ts CEL libraries were removed in M6; both hosts now evaluate via the same wasm). There is no upstream CEL-package version to pin -- the wasm engine identity is the sha256 in relay_contracts.wasm_artifact.WASM_PINNED_SHA256, and the nightly drift workflow (.github/workflows/nightly-cel-drift.yml) records that wasm pin + the wasmtime runtime version as the sole CEL-engine provenance and runs the corpus on it as a canary. Rotating the cel-spec pin REQUIRES re-running the generator (rewrites MANIFEST.sha256 + celspec_vectors.json + relay-profile-filter.yaml + dropped-candidates.json) and bumping last_refreshed_at.
